welcome.title: An honest picture of this moment
welcome.description: The Life Wheel helps you see balance and choose where to place your energy. It is not a grade — it is a starting point.

tabs.title: Assess, follow, and understand
tabs.description: Use Current Assessment to capture today, History to revisit change, and Insights to compare periods and discover patterns.

chart.title: Watch your balance take shape
chart.description: The chart responds to each life-area score. Areas near the center may need attention; wider areas show where you feel more satisfied.

scores.title: Answer for what is true today
scores.description: Adjust each control from 1 to 10 based on the present, not the ideal. Move through the areas calmly and trust your first perception.

save.title: Mark this point on your path
save.description: Save the assessment to create a reference in your history. You can update today’s entry if your perception changes.

history.title: Look back on your growth
history.description: In History, select dates, compare assessments, and play the timeline to notice changes that are hard to see from day to day.

insights.title: Turn data into direction
insights.description: Insights compares two moments, highlights gains and declines, and helps you choose one focus area without trying to change everything at once.

finish.title: Awareness comes before change
finish.description: Take your first assessment with kindness and choose only one area to observe. Use “How it works” whenever you want to revisit the process.
